'''Alix''' is a [[Warder]].

==Activities==

After losing his [[Aes Sedai]] during the [[Last Battle]], Alix joins [[Galad Damodred|Galad Damodred's]] forces. He fights with terrible ferocity.

== Trivia ==
* Alix is named after Alex Prescott, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
